decisions.reason: A cheap accessory that complements the core trailer range ties up few resources, so slack carries it, though its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.
Box trailers are the firm's core business and likely benefited from strong private demand during the pandemic, so results probably meet aspirations and no problemistic search is triggered.
High covers extend the core box trailer line with little extra resource use, so management keeps them despite the 2019 pruning of weaker lines and the lack of recent website evidence.
